items.prompt: A bike costs 80 dollars. Fitri has saved 30 percent of the price. Build a model with 10 equal units, each worth 10 percent, and say what one unit is worth in dollars.
hints: 10 percent is one tenth, so the whole is 10 units.
Saved is 3 units and still needed is 7 units.
items.explanation: 80 divided by 10 is 8, so one unit is 8 dollars. Fitri has saved 3 units, which is 24 dollars.
